source_text: Obstetric outcomes are particularly compromised, as evidenced by a WHO multicenter prospective study across six African countries involving 28,393 deliveries, which found women with FGM faced a 32% higher likelihood of postpartum hemorrhage, 66% increased need for instrumental delivery, and 55% greater risk of stillbirth or early neonatal death compared to uncircumcised women. [64]
